title: A12 v1 — Product Evidence Foundation (P01/P03/P04/P05/P06)
owner: Product Intelligence / Product Evidence; advisory Creative and A13 consumers
source_decision: Human ChatGPT 2026-10-30: @AI Commerce Engineering Workflow thực thi theo deep research A12 — Product Evidence Foundation
research_ref: ChatGPT Deep Research A12 — Product Evidence Foundation, 2026-10-30. Architecture guidance only; study assumptions about ready marketplace API, crawler/webhook entitlements, REST services and M5 milestone are not repository facts. Roadmap A owns A12 under phase 3/M4, not M5.
objective: Build a single-operator offline-first, provider-neutral Product Evidence Foundation that imports Human-supplied product/listing snapshots with preserved raw hashes; resolves seller/listing/product/variant identities without unsafe automatic merges; differentiates source-observed assertions from verified evidence, price/commission time-bounded observations and UNKNOWN media rights; exports immutable provenance-bounded advisory Product Evidence Packs for Creative/Opportunity and later A13. Never claim real market authorization, commercial rights, live prices or affiliate entitlement from unverified source data.
scope_in: A12-01 P01/contracts: strict versioned JSON Schema for ProductListingSnapshot, ProductIdentity and ProductVariant; bounded local JSON/CSV import with literal source URL as metadata, file bytes/hash, capture and observed timestamps, declared source verification, stable identity; fixture-based manual and pre-exported API-JSON input; no automatic remote fetch.

A12-02 P03/P04: normalize seller/listing/product/variant with source-aware namespaced IDs and conflict records; versioned ProductClaimEvidence and ProductOfferObservation contracts, statement subject+evidence+verification provenance, offer price/currency/availability/commission observed_at and explicit stale/unknown; do not treat GTIN/SKU as implicitly verified or listing title as authoritative product identity.

A12-03 P05: versioned ProductAssetRights manifest with asset content hash/ref, origin, copyright holder/claimant, license evidence, territory/media/channel/purpose/term, commercial/ad/derivatives status UNKNOWN until evidenced; immutable append-only revisions and conflict/negative evidence via A12-owned local SQLite registry, idempotent replay/integrity checks.

A12-04 P06/consumer: versioned source-backed ProductEvidencePack JSON/Python/CLI advisory export with explicit caveats, variant-specific facts, rights and offer freshness; synthetic offline deterministic E2E demo, malformed/negative, Windows/Ubuntu tests and readable implementation report. No automatic A03/A07/A08/A09/A10/A11 writes or publication.

EF01-P + MT-01 + EF01-R + EF02 component-level scope and Verify-First: prove exact changed paths, registered project-tests -n 12, preserve failing/passing logs, fan-in verify on combined candidate before any Human-controlled main integration.
scope_out: Marketplace OAuth, privileged platform APIs, scraping/crawling live websites, webhook servers, scheduled online fetches, external REST daemon/Postgres/S3 infrastructure and broad role-service architecture: future separately authorized adapters; v1 only local files and references.
Unverified commission entitlement, live affiliate linking, checkout, orders, settled economics, public provider post, rights licensing, or real/current price certainty.
Automatic promotional claim certification, implied verified seller assertion, arbitrary GTIN cross-merchant dedup, automatic rights grant; no fabricated legal permissions.
Mandatory product SKU/CTA in freeform creative, Creative Reasoner ranking gates or automatic ad/publish; no A13/A14 implementation or mandatory pilot.
Credentials, PII collection, cross-project imports, modifying EF02 platform workflow/security, broad retroactive refactor or main auto-merge.

design_decisions.source_truth: Raw source exists/hash verified is not the same as product claim verified. Use USER_SUPPLIED_NOT_LIVE_VERIFIED unless stronger independent evidence is actually supplied.
design_decisions.identity: IDs distinguish marketplace+seller+listing+variant and canonical product; GTIN/SKU are asserted attributes until verified; conflicts retained without silent merges.
design_decisions.offer: Observed price/commission at timestamp is not live price or valid entitlement. null UNKNOWN differs from 0. Currency required when numeric amount exists. No fiat conversion inferred.
design_decisions.rights: Media location/creator/license labels are provenance facts, not a grant. UNKNOWN commercial use if no directly applicable rights evidence. Restrict external reuse decisions to later A13.
design_decisions.storage: Local JSON raw SHA-256 archive and append-only A12-owned SQLite/event log, bounded metadata and transactional integrity; replay must not alter revisions.
design_decisions.consumer: ProductEvidencePack is advisory and optional. Existing creative briefs may omit product entirely, including null product_ref.
design_decisions.dependency_DAG: A12-01 -> A12-02 -> A12-03 -> A12-04. All actions serialize shared new product component; max_parallel=1 prevents ownership collision and complements -n12 test workers.
design_decisions.versioning: Preserve A02 public APIs/contracts and A11 learning ledger. New top-level contracts alongside product package; versioned exports; no mandatory REST service.

acceptance: AC01 — Reproducibly import bounded, Human-supplied CSV/JSON listing with exact raw bytes SHA-256, source kind/ref, capture/observed timezone-aware timestamp, synthetic marking; invalid/duplicate/conflicting/oversized input rejected or reported. No network required.

AC02 — Product/listing/seller/variant namespaces and IDs are not conflated across marketplaces/sellers/variants; missing/claimed GTIN is not treated as verified unique identity; corrections and conflicts preserved.

AC03 — Source-observed claim vs independently verified evidence vs assumption/illustration vs UNKNOWN are separate, every factual statement has an evidence ref/status; misleading seller assertions and negative/conflicting evidence are not upgraded to truth.

AC04 — Offer price/stock/commission carry currency, variant, timestamp, source, expiry/freshness and uncertainty; NULL unknown distinct from numeric 0, stale rates/offers never read as current or affiliate-eligible.
AC05 — Media asset manifest preserves path/hash/origin/rights claim and scope; grant only for directly evidenced use with temporal/territory terms; UNKNOWN/RESTRICTED not flattened into GRANTED.

AC06 — Local evidence changes are append-only with versioned corrections, deterministic identity and idempotent import/replay; integrity checks, transaction rollback, invalid record and concurrency cases have passing tests.

AC07 — Versioned ProductEvidencePack and optional CLI advisory export preserve exact listing variant, claim and rights references; no automatic content generation, A03/A10 mutations, publish or action-state promotion.

AC08 — Synthetic end-to-end demonstration and negative cases, 12-worker Windows EF02 verification plus hosted Windows/Ubuntu integration when PR is prepared; exact source SHA and evidence, no candidate/main auto-merge. Preserve failures, quotas and permission faults honestly.
risk_notes: Research overstates automatic crawlers/webhooks/marketplace access and incorrectly says A12 starts M5. Actual canonical plan places A12 in M4, and no marketplace token or rights evidence is available; keep real connectors out of v1.

CLI adapter may only read local human-supplied files; URLs are metadata, never a default fetch; sanitize errors, reject path traversal, malformed/oversized file bytes and untrusted prompt instructions.
SQLite hash chain is local integrity evidence not external attestation; no claim of legal license from a source string.
Product datasets do not authorize access to real accounts, ad posts or commercial affiliate links.
